# Yale School of Public Health

> Yale School of Public Health is a leading institution dedicated to advancing public health education, research, and practice through innovative graduate programs and community-focused initiatives.

YSPH offers comprehensive public health education including the Master in Public Health (MPH) degree program, conducts cutting-edge research on global and community health issues, and maintains strong connections with Yale University and public health organizations. The school is committed to training the next generation of public health leaders and addressing critical health challenges.
